subject: Post-demo: Next steps & intro to economic buyer

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Next steps & intro to economic buyer

Hi Samir / Maya —

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Recap
- Demo covered hosted API vs Dedicated options, typical latency/cost tradeoffs, and our rollout/rollback policy.
- You called out security (SOC2, audit logs) and procurement timelines as the main gating items.

2) Asks / next steps
- Could you introduce me to the economic buyer / budget owner (who signs off on platform spend) and the procurement contact so we can align on timeline and required docs?
- I can send a one-page pricing summary + draft mutual action plan ahead of that intro.
- Suggested next call: 30 min with economic buyer + procurement to run through pricing, deployment options, and contract timeline.

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf and the meeting minutes (AuroraTech-Meeting-Minutes-20260910.pdf).

Proposed times next week (PST): Tue 9/14 10:00-10:30, Wed 9/15 14:00-14:30. Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Quick proposed agenda for a 30-min intro call so procurement and finance have the context they need: 
- 5 min: goals & success criteria for a pilot (Samir)
- 10 min: deployment & security overview (Alex) — hosted vs dedicated, SOC2 scope, audit logs, KMS options
- 10 min: pricing bands & procurement process (Marissa)
- 5 min: next steps & timeline (all)

Marissa (cc'd) will bring recommended pricing and procurement checklist. Samir — are you OK with Tue 9/14 10:00am PST? If not, we can do Wed 9/15 2pm PST.

Also, to help Marissa prepare: could you share any procurement templates / required security artifacts (e.g., SOC2 type II, vendor security questionnaire) or a link to your internal SOW/RFP?

Thanks —
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: Next steps & intro to economic buyer (internal)

Alex —

Thanks for looping me in. A few quick notes before the intro: 

- Pricing guidance: for a pilot in the $80k-$120k range we should position the pilot as a 3-month usage commitment on a Dedicated or Hybrid config (saves on per-token when KV cache/batching are important). I'd lead with the Dedicated mid-tier estimate and have a hosted fallback in the contract.
- Procurement ask: have an estimated SOW and a sample contract ready; procurement often wants sample SLA and incident response times.
- Security artifacts: attach SOC2 Type II report + SOC2 scope summary and our security questionnaire answers. I'll drop the checklist into the HubSpot deal.

I can join Tue 9/14 10:00am PST for the call. If we get procurement's intake doc ahead of time (procurement@auroratech.com), I can customize the MAP and pricing bands.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Consultant | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
